header.userPrompt:
Finish applying the web module's form principle to the last two `FormData` classes that still hold raw user inputs: `MerchantFormData` and `RefundFormData`. Web module only. Do NOT change any API request/response models, and do NOT add anything to `lib/common` or `lib/api`. Keep every new validated type under `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits`.

## The principle (already documented, already enforced on the other forms)

On a `FormData` subclass, every field holding a value the user can enter or choose is a `FormField[T]` over a validated primitive, and every such field is in the `fields` list so `isValid` covers it. The only non-`FormField` members allowed are a `Boolean` and a genuine non-edited pass-through context id. See the rule in `.orca/reviewers/frontend.md` (the FormData sections). `SubscriptionFormData`, `BankRowRefundFormData`, `BankRowExpenseFormData`, `ExpenseFormData`, `ReceiptConfirmFormData`, `BulkExpenseFormData` already follow it; these two were left as a follow-up and now need the same treatment.

## Existing tools to reuse (do not re-create)

- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpNotes.scala` — bounded notes primitive with a `given` optional validator. Input objects `NotesInput` / `OptionalNotesInput` are in `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/components/inputs/expInputs.scala`.
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpOptionalId.scala` — `FormField[Option[UUID]]` validator for an existing-only id selection (blank = None, else a well-formed UUID). Input object `OptionalIdSelectInput` is in `expInputs.scala`.
- `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExistingSelections.scala` — `defaultCategoryId(merchantId, merchants)` and helpers; keep using it.
- Primitive templates to mirror for the one new primitive: `ExpNotes.scala` (a `WrappedString`-style bounded text clone) and `lib/common/.../CategoryDescription.scala` (shape only; do not edit lib).
- Reference FormData + spec shape: `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/BankRowRefundFormData.scala` and its spec under `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/forms`.

## New primitive to add

`web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpTaxId.scala` — a bounded free-text tax-id primitive built like `ExpNotes`: `MaxLength = 50` (matches the server, which rejects a tax id over 50 chars in `CreateMerchantAction`/`UpdateMerchantAction`). Provide `validate`/`parse`/`trusted`, a `given TextValidator`, and a `given` optional validator (blank = `None`). Add input objects to `expInputs.scala` (`TaxIdInput` / `OptionalTaxIdInput`) following the existing ones; no hardcoded React key in a reusable input (derive from the field name). Add a spec `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/ui/forms/ExpTaxIdSpec.scala` (plain ScalaTest, describe blocks named by method only, e.g. `"validate"` not `"ExpTaxId.validate"`).

Notes fields reuse `ExpNotes` (consistent with the other forms); do not add a second notes primitive.

## Fix 1: MerchantFormData + MerchantsPage

File: `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/MerchantFormData.scala`, rendered by `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/merchants/MerchantsPage.scala`.

- `notes: String` -> `FormField[Option[ExpNotes]]`.
- `categoryId: String` -> `FormField[Option[UUID]]` via `ExpOptionalId` / `OptionalIdSelectInput` (MerchantsPage picks an existing category from a select; this is existing-only, not pick-or-create, so no `ExistingOrNewValue`).
- `taxId: String` -> `FormField[Option[ExpTaxId]]`.
- Put all of these in `fields` so `isValid` covers them. Keep `name` as is. Keep both `submitRequest` (-> `CreateMerchant.Request`) and `updateRequest` (-> `UpdateMerchant.Request`); map the field values to the existing request shapes (notes/taxId become `Option[String]` via the primitive's `.string`, categoryId stays `Option[UUID]`). Drop the hand-written `parsedCategoryId` `Try(UUID.fromString)` and the `formValidationErrors` that only re-expresses field validity; rely on `isValid`. Seed fields from source with the raw value (no `.trim`/`.take`, no `.trusted`). Remove the now-stale "length is validated by the action" comment.
- Update `MerchantsPage` to render the validated inputs (`OptionalNotesInput`, `OptionalIdSelectInput`, `OptionalTaxIdInput`) and gate submit on `isValid` through the existing `useSubmit` handle. Keep js/MUI interop inside the component.

## Fix 2: RefundFormData + RefundsPage

File: `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/forms/RefundFormData.scala`, rendered by `web/src/main/scala/net/wiringbits/components/pages/expenses/RefundsPage.scala`.

- `merchantId: Option[UUID]` -> `FormField[Option[UUID]]` via `ExpOptionalId` / `OptionalIdSelectInput` (RefundsPage uses existing-only selects).
- `categoryId: Option[UUID]` -> `FormField[Option[UUID]]` the same way.
- `notes: String` -> `FormField[Option[ExpNotes]]`.
- Put all three in `fields`. Preserve the `withMerchant` behavior (picking a merchant sets the category to that merchant's default via `ExistingSelections.defaultCategoryId`, clearing it when the merchant has none) - now operating on the `FormField`s rather than raw ids. `submitRequest` keeps returning the same `Resolved` shape. Seed from `fromRefund` with raw values.
- Update `RefundsPage` to render the validated select/notes inputs and gate submit on `isValid`.

## Specs

- Add/update `MerchantFormDataSpec` and `RefundFormDataSpec` under `web/src/test/scala/net/wiringbits/forms` (plain ScalaTest, no jsdom): `submitRequest`/`updateRequest` yield a request when valid and `None` when a required field is missing or any field is invalid, and `RefundFormData.withMerchant` sets the default category. Method-only describe blocks.
- `ExpTaxIdSpec` as above.

## Acceptance criteria

- `web` compiles.
- `MerchantFormData` and `RefundFormData` hold no raw user-input member: every input is a `FormField` over a validated primitive and is in `fields`. (No `Boolean`/pass-through-id members are involved here.)
- New `ExpTaxId` primitive + inputs added with a spec; `MerchantFormDataSpec` and `RefundFormDataSpec` added/updated; all pass. Describe blocks method-only.
- No `.trusted` on user input; validated fields seeded raw; submit gated on `isValid` with no hand-written required/validity checks.
- No changes outside `web/`; no API request/response model changes; nothing added to `lib/`.
- All reviewer gates in `.orca/reviewers/frontend.md` satisfied. Repo is public: no PII anywhere.

Commit per form/primitive. Open a PR when done.
